verdict.rationale: NotebookLM supports chatting with multiple uploaded sources, generating custom reports (e.g., briefing documents, FAQs) and citing sources, which can approximate ad-hoc extraction, but there's no evidence of a structured, repeatable screening/extraction workflow (e.g., applying consistent inclusion/exclusion criteria or a data-extraction template) across a large corpus of papers. Community feedback also notes it cannot auto-search/pull in new docs, limiting systematic batch processing. Missing for 10: documented support for structured multi-paper screening criteria, batch extraction templates, and independent evidence of applying consistent criteria across many papers.
